visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man is seen from the chest up wearing a light grey t-shirt with the word 'Hurley' printed on it. He has a grey and yellow fabric hood pulled completely over his head and face, obscuring his features. He stands in front of a tan curtain, adjusting the back of the hood with his right hand. (2) The man brings his left hand up to his face underneath the hood, pushing the fabric outward with his knuckles to create a rounded, protruding shape near the center of the hood's surface. (3) A second person's hand enters the frame from the bottom left, holding up a printed 3D ultrasound image of a fetus. The ultrasound photo is positioned next to the man's hooded head for comparison. (4) The man suddenly pulls the fabric hood upward and off his head with both hands, revealing a young male with short dark hair. He looks at the camera with a wide smile and begins to talk and laugh while the ultrasound photo remains held in front of him.
